title: Radio: Manual Mode Transition — NAOH-FC-203 Set to 0 mg/L

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Control, this is HMI Operator Rios. I've just completed the manual mode transition per ERP Section 7.5.1. NAOH-FC-203 has been set to 0 mg/L via the local stroke dial on PLC-02. HSP-1/2/3 pumps are now in HAND mode at the MCC. Northgate Booster Station (BP-301/302/303) has been switched to local pressure-switch control (PIT-622). The HMI shows 'Manual Mode' and 'Running' for all three. I've double-checked the physical indicators: the caustic pump is off, and the pressure in Zone 1 is holding at 52 psi. We are now in full manual control.

fields.voiceStyle: Young male, steady, focused, with a faint background hum of SCADA console fans

instructorNote: This confirms the manual operation transition has been completed per ERP Section 7.5.1. The technical team must now verify that all critical systems are under direct operator control and that no residual automation is active.
